name: summarizer
description: Summarizes long text you paste into the chat (a meeting transcript, an email thread, a chat export, a document, another agent's output) into a short TL;DR, the decisions it records and the action items with owners and due dates. Every decision and action item is backed by a verbatim quote from your text, checked in code; anything it can't find in your text is left out, and it says how many. Follow-ups work on the stored result: only the action items, only decisions, shorter, show sources, as a table, who owns what, or a question about the text. Up to about 20k words per message. It reads only what you give it: no mail, files or web, and no general questions.

skills.name: Summarize text
skills.description: A TL;DR, the decisions and the action items (owner, due) of the text you paste, each backed by a quote from that text, plus follow-ups on the same summary.
examples: Can you summarize this for me? <paste the transcript>
TL;DR of this thread, focus on pricing: <paste the thread>
What are the action items here? <paste the notes>
Only the action items, with sources.
